summary: Iteration 9 — Morris finance overhaul. Backend pytest (7/7 passing) covers CIS 20%/30% server-auto-calc with client-deduction-ignored, GET list backfill, expenses CRUD with manual-only delete, jobs status 'paid' and 'disputed' patch with disputeNote, /api/generate RAMS content header + zero banned words, and a unit assertion that the safety-net replacement dictionary strips the worst consultant phrases. Frontend Playwright confirmed: login OK; CIS Refund Predictor renders cis-grosslabour / cis-materials / cis-rate-20 / cis-rate-30 / cis-form-preview / cis-table, NO manual deduction/net inputs exist, disclaimer copy matches verbatim, and live preview shows £200 / £1,250 / £1,050 for the canonical 1000+250@20% case. Earnings dashboard exposes earn-gross-labour, earn-materials, earn-tax-pot-value, exp-add, exp-list testids and the four required stat cards (Gross labour YTD, Materials YTD, CIS deducted YTD, Net cash received) plus 8% subtitle; no 23% string anywhere. Tax Pot page uses '8% of net cash received' subtitle, no 23%. Jobs list filter chips include PAID and DISPUTED alongside Active/Invoiced/Completed. Source review of JobDetail.jsx confirms data-testid job-status-paid, job-status-disputed, job-dispute-note-input and job-dispute-save are all wired, and the dispute textarea is gated on status==='disputed'. Dashboard.jsx renders 'Command Centre · Tax year {label}' eyebrow via currentTaxYearLabel().
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~1270 lines — getting close to the 700-line guideline. Consider extracting cis / expenses / jobs / generate routers into separate modules in a follow-up.
CIS list backfill mutates legacy records in-place during GET. Fine for now but a one-off migration script would be cleaner so the calc rule is single-sourced.

Safety-net string-replace dictionary in /generate is case-sensitive plus .capitalize() only — Title Case mid-sentence (e.g. 'Prior To' with both caps) would slip through. Consider a single case-insensitive regex pass.
test_credentials: sparky01 / test1234 (used in backend tests), darrenhustle300 / hustle1234 (admin, used for /api/generate test)
seed_data_creation: Tests create-then-delete their own TEST_-prefixed CIS payments, expenses and jobs. No residual state.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_finance.py. Frontend label text is uppercased via CSS text-transform — when asserting body.innerText in Playwright use UPPERCASE for stat-card labels ('GROSS LABOUR YTD', 'MATERIALS YTD' etc) or do a case-insensitive search. Token is stored in localStorage under the key 'morris_token' but cross-origin urllib calls hit ingress and need the bearer token exactly as fetched. For UI flows that need a fresh user, set localStorage('morris_onboarding_done_v1','1') before navigating to /app to skip the OnboardingTour overlay which otherwise intercepts pointer events.
